review_description: One word : Fantastic!The guys at Green Electric have a solid team and are absolute pros. They are very knowledgeable, while being extremely polite, pleasing and put the customers' satisfaction above all. I recently got them to install a 10+ kW solar system at my house, and they were wonderful from start to finish. Since the first meeting with them where I was introduced to some detailed technical concepts explained everything so patiently by Qasim, while giving me options that would suit my budget, and accommodating even some superior brands/products within the same budget, till the installation, - it was all so smooth. Post the installation, they guided me through the system and also helped organize the grid connection + inspection.  I'd highly recommend to anyone who's looking to install a solar system. Do reach out to them for a consult. As a bonus, they have inhouse installation teams as well which are directly supervised by the company and they definitely do a superior job.

Green Electric Solutions were not one of the recommended companies but did a great job at our place. Quick turnaround from signing contract to installation, absolutely no problems on the day of install.Good communication throughout.
